title: I wanted to build a first person finger/mouse swinging baseball roguelike
author: WeightNational9457
selftext:
I always thought baseball games would be more fun it I could feel like I was swinging the bat or catching the the ball in first person view. I think it works but it took me some time to get use to, I want to gather some feedback on the mechanism. There is also a cute story, I'd also like to hear some feedback on that. I know it looks a lot like backyard baseball, but I think it plays completely different. The game is fully finished, I built this fully with claude with no assets.  


Play the game on mobile for the best playing experience.  
  
[https://playfaat.com/neighborhood/](https://playfaat.com/neighborhood/)
